/regions/[back_hill]/description: A gentle hill right behind the village. Wood and iron ore just lying around—a rookie's playground!
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[boar]/des: Charges blindly when mad! Mind your butt.
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[bees]/des: Sweet, as long as you skip the hive. Mostly.
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[squirrel]: Throws acorns. They hurt more than you'd think.
/regions/[old_mine]/description: A mine abandoned long ago. Dark and damp, but they say coal and silver are still buried everywhere!
/regions/[old_mine]/monsters/[mine_slime: Slippery and sticky underfoot. Your shoes will cry.
/regions/[old_mine]/monsters/[golem_kid]: Small, but a rock is a rock. Dodge if it rolls!
/regions/[goblin_forest]/description: Deep woods where goblins made camp. Leather and shiny manastones—and plenty of traps!
/regions/[goblin_forest]/monsters/[gobli: Sneaks after you, then drums up its friends.
/regions/[goblin_forest]/monsters/[toads: One whiff of spores and the world goes spinny.
/regions/[goblin_forest]/monsters/[giant: Sticky webs. Great at swinging away, too.
/regions/[volcano]/description: A hot cave of bubbling lava. Mithril and firestone await—but your soles might melt!
/regions/[volcano]/monsters/[lava_slime]: Looks squishy, but ouch, hot! Gloves required.
/regions/[volcano]/monsters/[fire_lizard: Its tail's on fire. Sometimes that surprises even it.
/regions/[volcano]/monsters/[ash_imp]/de: A prankster that tosses ash and runs off giggling.
/regions/[dragon_nest]/description: An old dragon naps in this mountaintop nest. The trick: sneak off with fallen scales! Don't jump at the snoring.
/regions/[dragon_nest]/monsters/[wyvern_: Peeps for its mama. Pecks like a grown-up, though.
/regions/[dragon_nest]/monsters/[drake_g: A dutiful nest guard. Mustn't doze off. Keeps dozing off.
/regions/[dragon_nest]/monsters/[sleepy_: Do NOT wake it! Sometimes breathes fire in its sleep.
/regions/[frost_canyon]/description: Crunch with every step! Frost crystals sparkle in every crack. Slip, and you'll be sliding a long way.
/regions/[frost_canyon]/monsters/[frost_: Every flap freezes its snot. Its weapon? Sneezes.
/regions/[frost_canyon]/monsters/[snow_y: Snowball champ. Getting hit is less ouch, more brrr.
/regions/[frost_canyon]/monsters/[ice_go: Slow and tough. On sunny days it's a little melty.
/regions/[sky_ruins]/description: Ancient ruins floating above the clouds. Strong winds—hold onto your hat! A Sky Core is hidden here, they say.
/regions/[sky_ruins]/monsters/[ruin_wisp: Pretends to guide you, then leads you astray. Little rascal.
/regions/[sky_ruins]/monsters/[stone_gua: Same spot for a thousand years. Its legs fell asleep ages ago.
/regions/[sky_ruins]/monsters/[sky_drake: Whoosh through the clouds! Can't resist anything shiny.
